        return len(self._xs)

    def hasXs(self):
        return len(self._xs) > 0

    def addX(self, aX):

        return True

    def removeX(self, aX):
        oldIndex = next((i for i, x in enumerate(self._xs) if x is aX), -1)
        if oldIndex == -1:
            return False
        del self._xs[oldIndex]
        if aX.indexOfY(self) != -1 and not aX.removeY(self):
            self._xs.insert(oldIndex, aX)
            return False
        return True

            return False

            index = 0
        if index > self.numberOfXs():
            index = self.numberOfXs() - 1

        return True

    def addOrMoveXAt(self, aX, index):
